Greater-brand-recognition.info-p1: The brand of a business is something intangible and tangible at the same time. It is an element that goes far beyond its name, slogan and visual identity.
Greater-brand-recognition.info-p2: In general terms, we can say that the brand is everything with which a company is related and identified, which entails virtues, values, tone of voice, colors, products or services, price-quality ratio and much more.
Greater-brand-recognition.title: Greater brand recognition

Access-to-the-new-generations.info-p1: The companies that stand the test of time and consolidate in certain market segments are those that constantly attract and captivate new generations of consumers.
Access-to-the-new-generations.info-p2: Logically, to achieve this it is necessary to know the consumption patterns of the youngest users and their concerns, needs, problems and objectives.
Access-to-the-new-generations.title: Access to the new generations

Obtaining-relevant-data-and-information.info-p1: Once you consolidate the digital presence of your business, relevant information of interest will begin to reach you in a systematic and constant way.
Obtaining-relevant-data-and-information.info-p2: Elements as basic as user comments on social networks and the evaluation of a product in an online store make it possible to understand the public's perception and, thus, find or detect areas for improvement.
Obtaining-relevant-data-and-information.title: Obtaining relevant data and information

Statistics.title: Statistics
Statistics.info-title: In data, why is it so important to have a Digital Presence?
Statistics.info-subtitle: Do you know what happens worldwide in just 1 minute on the Internet?
Statistics.info-pr1-1: There are 4,497,420 searches on Google alone.
Statistics.info-pr1-3: LNetflix users watch a total of 694,444 hours of video.
Statistics.info-pr1-4: There are 277,777 story posts on Instagram and 55,140 posts in the feed.
Statistics.info-pr1-5: YouTube users watch a total of 4,500,000 videos.
Statistics.info-pr2-1: A figure worth delving into is the number of searches performed per minute on Google. There are approximately 6 billion searches per day around the world, and per year there are 2,190 billion. Therefore, if we do not have a presence on Google we are really wasting a tremendous opportunity.

Aboutme.title: About me
Aboutme.presentation: Hello, I'm Oscar, I've been working as a web developer since 2019. I want to share a little about my experience and what drove me to be passionate about this beautiful profession.
Aboutme.exp-1-1: I started in software development working independently, I programmed some landing pages and databases for clients in the sales and entertainment area. In 2020 I started working
Aboutme.exp-1-2: with the position of Sr. programming analyst developing with React js, React Native, Wordpress, Laravel among others, but mainly with CRM Salesforce, a technology that seems very useful and scalable to me.
Aboutme.exp-2-1: In 2023 I started a new challenge working at
Aboutme.exp-2-2: where I was assigned as a customer to
Aboutme.exp-2-3: working as a Salesforce Sr. developer. Without a doubt I can say that it was a very enriching stage in which I acquired a lot of knowledge as a Salesforce developer and consultant.
Aboutme.exp-3-1: I'm currently working as a Salesforce Administrator and Developer at Scotiabank, where I design and implement solutions that improve internal workflows and enhance the customer experience. Since joining the team, I’ve been responsible for automating complex flows, integrating with external systems through APIs, and applying best practices to maintain large-scale Salesforce environments.
Aboutme.exp-3-2: In addition to my technical work, I collaborate closely with QA, DevOps, and architecture teams, which gives me a well-rounded view of each project’s lifecycle. This role has strengthened my technical expertise while also helping me grow in areas like problem-solving, analysis, and team collaboration.
Aboutme.exp-3-3: In parallel, I’ve been building backend projects using Node.js to gain deeper control over business logic outside Salesforce—always looking for new technical challenges that help me grow

Services.title: Services
Services.description-Salesforce: Salesforce is a customer relationship management solution that unites businesses and customers. It is an integrated CRM platform that gives all your departments, including marketing, sales, commerce and services, a single, shared view of each customer.
Services.description-Wordpress: WordPress is a web content management system (CMS or content management system), which in short is a system for publishing content on the web in a simple way. It is so common now that it has been the absolute world leader in website creation for many years.
Services.description-ReactJs: ReactJS es una de las librerías más populares de JavaScript para el desarrollo de aplicaciones móviles y web. Creada por Facebook, React contiene una colección de fragmentos de código JavaScript reutilizables utilizados para crear interfaces de usuario (UI) llamadas componentes.
Services.description-React-Native: React Native is a JavaScript framework to create real native applications for iOS and Android, based on the React JavaScript library for the creation of visual components, changing their purpose so that, instead of being executed in the browser, they run directly on the native mobile platforms, in this case iOS and Andorid.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At oscardanieldev.com, we value and respect your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website.
privacyPolicy.section1Text: We may collect personal information such as your name and email address if you choose to contact us through forms. We also collect non-personal data such as IP address, browser type, and pages visited, using cookies and analytics tools like Google Analytics.
privacyPolicy.section2Text: We use the information to respond to your inquiries, improve the site, and analyze traffic. We do not share your personal information with third parties, except when required by law.
privacyPolicy.section3Text: This site uses cookies to enhance user experience and analyze traffic. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but this may affect site functionality.
privacyPolicy.section4Text: Our site may contain links to other websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites. We recommend reviewing the privacy policies of any external sites you visit.
privacyPolicy.section5Text: We reserve the right to modify this policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this page and will take effect immediately upon publication.
privacyPolicy.section6Text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact us through our contact form.

cookiesNotice.title: Cookies Notice
cookiesNotice.intro: This website uses cookies to enhance user experience and analyze traffic. By continuing to browse, you accept the use of cookies.
cookiesNotice.section1Text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow us to remember your preferences and improve site functionality.
cookiesNotice.section2: What types of cookies do we use?
cookiesNotice.section2Text: We use our own and third-party cookies for technical, analytical, and personalization purposes. Analytical cookies help us understand how visitors interact with the site.
cookiesNotice.section3Text: You can configure your browser to accept or reject cookies, as well as delete those already stored. Please note that disabling cookies may affect site functionality.
cookiesNotice.section4Text: We reserve the right to modify this notice at any time. Changes will be posted on this page.
